resources.string: RaiseSteady Guard blocks adult sites, gives the apps you choose a daily time and a bedtime, and stops the protection being turned off without your PIN. Set it up on your child\'s phone or tablet. It takes about 5 minutes.
The age sets the blocked sites, safe search and the suggested times. You can change everything later.
You need the PIN to change the settings and to turn the protection off. Keep it to yourself.
The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits, and both must be the same.

AdGuard DNS Family, a free public service, also blocks adult sites, phishing and many ads. It sees the names of the sites opened and your internet address, as any DNS service does. Our own block lists work on this device in any case.
Android runs the filter as a VPN on this device: it checks the name of each site against our lists and sends nothing to us.
Android will say the app can monitor network traffic. Tap OK.
A notice shows that protection is on, and warns your child 5 minutes before game time ends.
This lets the app count how long each app is used today, for the time limits and your report. The numbers stay on this device.
Find RaiseSteady Guard and switch on Permit usage access.
Let RaiseSteady Guard see which app is open
Open Downloaded apps (or Installed apps), then RaiseSteady Guard, and switch it on.
If Android says Restricted setting: open App info for RaiseSteady Guard, tap the menu at the top right, then Allow restricted settings, and try again.
As a device admin app, RaiseSteady Guard cannot be uninstalled until it is switched off, and that page asks for your PIN.
Android then starts the filter by itself, and keeps the internet closed if the filter ever stops.
Tap the gear next to RaiseSteady Guard, then switch on Always-on VPN and Block connections without VPN.
Games start on Game time. Social and chat apps start blocked under the age in their own terms. Everything else stays allowed.
Private DNS is Automatic or Off.
Private DNS is set to %1$s. Set it to Automatic or Off, or the filter cannot work.
Date and time are set automatically.
Automatic date and time is off. Switch it on, so bedtime and game time are right.
Pause app activity if unused is off for this app.
Switch off Pause app activity if unused for RaiseSteady Guard.
This kind of phone may stop apps to save battery. Let RaiseSteady Guard run without battery limits.
Set up parental controls in the Play Store, so new apps need your OK.
Remove guest access in Settings, System, Multiple users.
Adult, gambling and filter-bypass sites are blocked
Safe search is on for Google, Bing and DuckDuckGo
Game time: %1$d min a day, %2$d min left today
Time limits and the settings guard are off: accessibility access is off.
Usage access is off: the app counts the minutes itself.
The app can be removed: device admin is off.
Always-on VPN is off: if the filter stops, the internet stays open.
Your parent can see how long apps are used on this device each day. The sites you open are not kept. It all stays on this device.

Android does not let an app stop a factory reset or safe mode, set Always-on VPN or Private DNS by itself, or cover guest users, other users or a private space. Someone with USB debugging can switch the protection off. Apps with their own encrypted DNS are not filtered, and the app cannot see inside apps or pages. Advanced Protection mode (Android 16) switches the time limits off.
They close at once and open again when the time ends.
Open game-time apps for a little longer: when today\'s game time is used up, at bedtime or in homework time. Then they close again.
Counted on this device. No site names are kept.
Saturday and Sunday use the weekend game time. Friday and Saturday nights use the weekend bedtime.
Weekend game time: %1$d min a day
Monday to Friday, game-time apps are closed in this window.
Homework time must end at least 15 minutes after it starts, on the same day.
Bedtime must last at least 15 minutes.
Sites you block stay closed in every browser at all times. Sites you allow open even when the filter would block them.
This does not look like a site address.
Settings pages need the parent PIN.
This takes every limit off this device.
Protection is off. To remove the app: Settings, Apps, RaiseSteady Guard, Uninstall. Also switch off Always-on VPN for it.
